name: ai-job-search
description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
one_liner: A do-it-yourself AI assistant that reads job postings, checks if you're a good fit, writes a tailored CV and cover letter, and preps you for the interview — running on your own computer.
buyer: A laid-off professional or career-changer doing a high-volume job search who can't afford a career coach but can follow a setup guide.
business_use_cases: A job seeker forks the repo, fills in their profile once, and runs it weekly to auto-screen and apply to dozens of postings with tailored materials.
A career coach sets this up for clients as a starter kit, charging a flat fee to configure it for the client's industry and local job boards.
A university career center runs workshops teaching students to set this up themselves instead of buying a commercial resume-tailoring subscription.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a one-time paid setup and configuration service for non-technical job seekers who can't install Claude Code, LaTeX, and Bun themselves.
Localize the job-portal search skills for a new country's job boards and sell that fork to local job seekers or a staffing agency.

steal_this: Package the setup as a paid one-hour 'install and configure this for your job search' session — the friction (LaTeX, Bun, Python) is exactly what people will pay to skip.
